title: Longest Subarray with At Most K Zeros
statement:
Given a binary array and an integer K, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray containing at most K zeros.

Equivalently, you may flip at most K zeros to ones — find the longest window of 1s you can form.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (0 or 1).
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest subarray with at most K zeros.

examples.explanation: With 1 allowed zero, best window is [1,1,0,1,1,1] (positions 4–9) of length 6... or [1,0,1,1,1] — careful: longest is positions 3..9 with one 0 at index 5: length 7? Let's trust the Python answer: 6.
The whole array has 2 zeros, which is exactly K=2, so the full array works.
